images.caption: Figure 1:A distillation attack’s pipeline.Attackers amass large volumes of reasoning traces from proprietary LLMs and train (“distill”) their own models on these traces, followed by further training of distilled models with reinforcement learning (RL). Existing threat models assume attackers train models only with distillation, while a realistic distillation attack likely follows distillation with RL.
